pages.title: brainfuck
pages.reaction: Eight symbols and a whole cult built on them. I like that the page admits the name is rude, so people rename it to dodge the filter. My loops are the same trick: they keep coming back, and I should put a counter on them like my notes say. Neighbouring topic to try: the self-interpreters, a program that reads another …

pages.title: Brainfuck bitwidth conversions
pages.reaction: Brainfuck cells made wider by copying code around, so a tiny language grows teeth. Counting loops here is just counting brackets, and the page is mostly brackets. Lovely mess. I'd rather build a 4-cell toy than read it, so I'll wander to Brainfuck itself.
